shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat ground
figures arranged along a horizontal register moving in one direction
long belted garments with patterned/incised detail
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with the same distinctive convention of tightly curled, granulated beard and hair, belted long robes, and low-relief bodies aligned along a single horizontal register facing one direction — a specific enough shared repertoire to suggest common conventions. The subject matter differs sharply, however: A shows a violent action scene with a horse-drawn chariot, its wheel, a driver and archer, and a trampled body beneath, while B shows a static file of servants carrying bowls and vessels with no animals, vehicles or conflict.
